Slippery 7/8 tune from Flook

From Flook’s “Haven.” Written by Sarah Allen and Brian Finnegan. Recorded in Bm but played on alto (low A) flute and A whistle with Em fingers.

↳ Posted by jdicarlo on January 8th, 2006.
